, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the namesake (General von Steuben) fought for the British Army, conflating German auxiliaries (Hessians) with von Steuben. This contradicted the evidence already gathered (and even the Planner’s own Step 7 note) that von Steuben served in the American Continental Army, leading directly to the wrong final answer.
